title: HSK1 Gate 5 · Qin Dynasty
explanationEn: Gate 5: Qin Dynasty. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第5关：秦朝。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 两千多年以前，中国有很多小国，常常打仗。后来，秦始皇打败了别的国，把中国变成了一个国家。他是中国的第一个皇帝。他让全国的人写一样的字，用一样的钱。
passageEn: More than two thousand years ago, China had many small states that were always fighting. Later, Qin Shi Huang defeated the other states and made China one country. He was China's first emperor. He made everyone in the country write the same characters and use the same money.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: More than two thousand years ago, China had many small states that were always fighting.
comprehension.answer: 两千多年以前，中国有很多小国，常常打仗。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？
comprehension.answer: 他是中国的第一个皇帝。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 两 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“两”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 两 (liǎng) means "two" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “两”（liǎng）的意思是“two”，就在上面的短文里。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 多 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“多”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 多 (duō) means "more than" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “多”（duō）的意思是“more than”，就在上面的短文里。

check.zh: 两千多年以前，中国有很多小国，常常打仗。

options.text: People had nowhere to live, and could only go up the mountains to live.
More than two thousand years ago, China had many small states that were always fighting.
Long ago, a great flood came to China.
The flood went into the fields, and into many people's homes.

check.explanationEn: "两千多年以前，中国有很多小国，常常打仗。" means "More than two thousand years ago, China had many small states that were always fighting.".
check.explanation: “两千多年以前，中国有很多小国，常常打仗。”的意思是“More than two thousand years ago, China had many small states that were always fighting.”。

speakingPromptEn: Tell a grown-up about Qin Dynasty in two or three short Chinese sentences. Use words from the list above.
speakingPrompt: 用上面的词，跟家里的大人说两三句中文，说一说秦朝。
